issue.body:
Adds accurate detection of global variable with eval in non-CSP environment, since it cannot be
reliably duck-typed for supported platforms. Keeps duck typing as fallback method for CSP.

Closes #16545

**Please check if the PR fulfills these requirements**

**What kind of change does this PR introduce?** (check one with "x")

```
[ ] Feature
[ ] Code style update (formatting, local variables)
[ ] Refactoring (no functional changes, no api changes)
[ ] Build related changes
[ ] CI related changes
[ ] Other... Please describe:
```

**What is the current behavior?** (You can also link to an open issue here)

Global variable is chosen between `window`, `self` and `global` based on duck test, the priority is given to `window`. This results in wrong global being chosen when more than one of them is defined, particularly in Node (`window` and `global`). See #16545

**What is the new behavior?**

Global variable is accurately detected with eval (`new Function('return this')`) and falls back to duck typing when eval is restricted with CSP.
